LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.description: Depending on ritual quality, participants gain a mood thought lasting {MOODDAYS} days, between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD}. Completing the Qixi rite also grants lost Qinghe score fragments, and better outcomes may inspire participants.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.comps.1.label: Qinghe present
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.comps.2.label: participant count
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.comps.3.label: started by lotus pond
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.0.label: terrible
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.0.descr: {0} was terrible. Wishes scattered into awkward silence, and no one found the expected melody.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.1.label: dull
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.1.descr: {0} was somewhat dull. The gathering was peaceful enough, but the music never truly settled.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.2.label: elegant
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.2.descr: {0} was quite elegant. Clear music and quiet wishes left everyone's heart lighter.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.2.poten: One participant may gain work frenzy or creative inspiration.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.3.label: inspired
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.3.descr: {0} stirred inspiration. The rite seemed briefly answered by an old melody beyond the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiOutcome.outcomeChances.3.poten: Two participants may gain work frenzy or creative inspiration.
